meta.title: Contact the team: bug, idea or question | Izacki
meta.description: Write to the Izacki team: a bug, an idea or a question. The form requires an account; the email address and the Discord are open to everyone.

hero.title: Contact
hero.lead: A bug, an idea or a question: write to us.

form.label: Form
form.title: Write to the team.
form.placeholder: Describe your problem, your idea or your question.
form.hint: Your message is sent from your Izacki account: the team receives your username, your email address and your text, sent through a messaging service.
form.success: Message sent. We will reply as soon as we can, by email if needed.

needLogin.title: Log in to write to us
needLogin.text: The form is for Izacki accounts only: your message is sent from your account, which lets us reply to you. Without an account, you can write to us by email or on Discord: see the other ways to reach us.

other.label: Other ways
other.title: Reach us another way.
other.supportText: In the Launcher, Support works through tickets: question, bug, refund or other. You can attach a screenshot; the reply arrives in the ticket.
other.delayText: We reply as soon as we can.

contact.notConfigured: The contact form is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes or write to us on Discord.
contact.sendFailed: The message could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
